input.title: Unisex Sauna – Hot and Not Talking. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

HOT AND NOT TALKING. is the sauna hoodie for the regular who goes in to sweat in silence, worn walking to the sauna, between rounds in the cool-down room and as a gift for the friend who guards the quiet.

HOT AND sits across the top in heavy rounded capitals and NOT TALKING. stacks in two huge lines below. Between them a stocky mustached man in a knit cap and a white towel sits on a wooden sauna bench, eyes closed and cheeks flushed, with a wooden bucket and ladle at his feet and steam curling around him.

Navy carries cream and terracotta lettering with a cream edge around the sauna scene; Sand gets deep brown and brick red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this sauna hoodie warm enough for walks to the sauna and cool-down breaks?
Yes. The Hot and Not Talking. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for walks to the sauna, cool-down breaks and cold evenings after the steam.

How does the Hot and Not Talking. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a sauna regular?
It is a natural one. Every sauna regular knows the unwritten rule of silence in the heat, so it lands with steam-room friends, cold-plunge fans and the family that waits outside. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the sauna scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Hot and Not Talking. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
